activity.notes: On 22 August 1825 the provisional authorities of the Oriental Province unanimously designated Juan Antonio Lavalleja Governor and Captain General. The government then declared independence from Portuguese-Brazilian rule on 25 August. Modern scholarship notes that Lavalleja delegated political command to Joaquín Suárez in mid-1826, so ATLAS leaves the 1826 endpoint approximate rather than inventing a day. The polity is the contemporary Oriental Province, not a retrojected fully constituted Oriental Republic of Uruguay, which emerged from the 1828 settlement and 1830 constitution.
